natural_options.name: Neem-based product
natural_options.use: May help with certain insect pests, but it is not a proven cure for early blight.

natural_options.name: Crop sanitation
natural_options.use: Remove badly affected leaves when appropriate, avoid wet foliage where possible, and remove diseased plant debris.

chemical_options.name: Azoxystrobin
chemical_options.use: Consider only a product labelled for tomato early blight in your area.

chemical_options.name: Mancozeb
chemical_options.use: Consider only if the exact product label permits this crop and disease use.

natural_options.name: Crop sanitation and moisture management
natural_options.use: Avoid prolonged leaf wetness and seek prompt expert advice because late blight can spread rapidly.

Late_blight.warning: Get the diagnosis confirmed promptly. Use only a currently labelled treatment recommended for tomato late blight.

natural_options.name: Crop sanitation
natural_options.use: Avoid handling wet plants, clean tools, and remove severely affected plant debris appropriately.

Bacterial_spot.warning: Do not use a fungicide as though it were a cure for bacterial disease.

natural_options.name: Improve airflow
natural_options.use: Provide adequate spacing and ventilation and avoid prolonged leaf wetness.

Leaf_Mold.warning: Confirm the diagnosis before selecting a fungicide.

natural_options.name: Crop sanitation
natural_options.use: Remove affected plant debris, avoid overhead watering where possible, and rotate crops.

Septoria_leaf_spot.warning: Any chemical treatment must be labelled for this disease on tomato.

natural_options.name: Neem-based product
natural_options.use: A labelled neem-based product may help manage mites. Follow its instructions and protect beneficial insects.

natural_options.name: Regular inspection
natural_options.use: Inspect leaf undersides and confirm mites before choosing a treatment.

Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider_mite.warning: Use a product specifically labelled for spider mites on tomato if chemical treatment is needed.

natural_options.name: Crop sanitation and airflow
natural_options.use: Remove diseased debris and improve airflow around plants.

Target_Spot.warning: Confirm the disease and check the exact product label before using a fungicide.

natural_options.name: Yellow sticky traps
natural_options.use: Monitor and catch some whiteflies. Traps alone may not prevent virus transmission.

natural_options.name: Remove infected plants appropriately
natural_options.use: Confirm infection and follow local agricultural advice to reduce spread.

Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.warning: No pesticide cures the virus inside the plant. Focus on prevention and whitefly management.

natural_options.name: Tool hygiene
natural_options.use: Clean tools and hands after handling infected plants, and follow local guidance for infected plants.

Tomato_mosaic_virus.warning: No pesticide cures the virus inside the plant.

natural_options.name: Routine monitoring
natural_options.use: Inspect leaves regularly and maintain appropriate watering and plant spacing.
